table.name: FINREV_FED_17
table.purpose: Census F-33 style school-district finance table for fiscal year 2017 (yr_data=17), one row per U.S. public school district (LEA), showing federal revenue amounts by source code. Companion lookup FINREV_FED_KEY_17 maps state codes (and likely revenue line codes) to labels. The NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 table suggests this database combines district finance with NAEP/assessment data via NCES IDs.

c14.name: federal_revenue_code_c14
c14.description: Federal revenue amount for Census F-33 line code C14, in thousands of dollars (consistent with other revenue columns). In the F-33 schema C14 is a specific federal aid category (likely Title I / revenue through the state), but the exact program cannot be confirmed without the code key table, so the specific program label is tentative. Zero for ~11% of districts.

c25.name: federal_revenue_code_c25
c25.description: Federal revenue amount for Census F-33 line code C25, in thousands of dollars. Likely a specific federal program category (plausibly special education/IDEA or another federal aid line), but the exact program cannot be confirmed from the data alone.

idcensus.name: census_district_id
idcensus.description: Census Bureau school-district (LEA) identifier: a FIPS-style composite code of state (2 digits) + county + district components (up to 14 digits), unique per row. Used to link to Census F-33 finance data.

nces_id.name: nces_lea_id
nces_id.description: NCES Local Education Agency (school district) ID, unique per row; the standard key for joining to other education datasets (e.g., NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8).

school_district.name: school_district_name
school_district.description: Name of the school district / LEA (e.g., 'LORAIN CITY SCH DIST'). Duplicated names across states (e.g., 'LINCOLN CO SCH DIST' appears 6 times) because district names are not unique nationally.

state_code.name: state_fips_code
state_code.description: FIPS state code (1-51, includes DC and other non-state codes), referencing FINREV_FED_KEY_17.State_Code which maps to state names (e.g., 24=Minnesota, 44=Texas, 51=Wyoming).

t_fed_rev.name: total_federal_revenue
t_fed_rev.description: Total federal revenue received by the district, in thousands of dollars (Census F-33 total federal revenue line). Ranges 0 to ~2,061,297 (thousands), median ~880.

yr_data.name: fiscal_year
yr_data.description: Year of the data, coded as 17 = fiscal year 2017 (matches the '_17' suffix of the table name). Constant across all rows.

table.name: FINREV_FED_KEY_17
table.purpose: Key/lookup table for the 2017 federal finance revenue survey (FINREV_FED_17): one row per U.S. state (51 rows incl. DC), mapping state names to FIPS state codes and giving the number of records per state in the main survey table.

#_Records.name: record_count
#_Records.description: Number of records (school districts / LEAs) reported for the state in FINREV_FED_17. Stored as text with thousands separators (e.g. '1,045'), so the numeric stats are approximate.

State.name: state_name
State.description: Full name of the U.S. state (or district); one row per state, 51 distinct values.

State_Code.name: state_fips_code
State_Code.description: FIPS state code (1-51, alphabetical order), primary key of this table; referenced by FINREV_FED_17.state_code.

table.name: NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8
table.purpose: NAEP (National Assessment of Educational Progress) 8th-grade mathematics average scale scores by state for 2017, for the 'All students' group. One row per state (plus a National aggregate).

all_students.name: student_group
all_students.description: Assessment population subgroup; constant value 'All students' indicating the row covers all students rather than a demographic subgroup.

average_scale_score.name: average_scale_score
average_scale_score.description: Average NAEP mathematics scale score for 8th grade, ranging 266-297 (NAEP math scale 0-500).

state.name: state
state.description: U.S. state name (50 states, plus 'National' for the national aggregate); uniquely identifies each row.
